extension.summary: Fullscreen XMLTV guide — maintained modernization Beta.
extension.description: Maintained modernization Beta of TV Guide Fullscreen: XMLTV listings, stream mappings, search, reminders and ordinary AutoPlay. Bounded Nexus 20.5 core evidence is reused for unchanged code; audio, timer delivery and broader compatibility remain limited. Thanks for the major contributions from: iainmacleod, im85288, RayW1986, bluezed, andy, Zomboided, tycoo, kjb86, Doctor-Eggs
extension.disclaimer: Based on the original TV Guide addon by twinther, FTV Guide and Midraal's fork.
extension.news: 0.1.0 Beta: maintained modernization fork. Unchanged code reuses bounded Nexus 20.5 core evidence, not an exact beta ZIP native install. Audio untested; timed reminder delivery and actual AutoPlay firing unobserved. Static gate remains FAIL. Historical Matrix/Omega/Piers RC2 evidence is not current beta acceptance. Official pytz is required separately; Program and background service remain. See the maintained fork README for download and repository admission status.
